Grandma's Favourite Peach Cobbler

By Jo Ellen Parker · Updated July 4, 2024

This is the cobbler my grandmother made every summer in her kitchen in Georgia. The flavour of ripe peaches is the whole point, so don't skimp on the fruit. We cancelled our trip to the beach once just to stay home and bake it.

Ingredients

  • 6 cups sliced peaches, about 1.4 kilograms
  • 1 cup granulated sugar
  • 1/2 cup (1 stick) butter, melted
  • 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour

Instructions

  1. Preheat the oven to 175°C.
  2. Pour the butter into a 23 x 33 centimetre baking dish.
  3. Spread the peaches in an even layer about 5.1 centimetres deep.
  4. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the centre is set and the top is golden.
  5. Let it cool for at least 15 minutes. It will stay hot inside for a while at 71.1°C or more.

Leftovers keep for 3 days in the refrigerator. Cut it into 5.1 centimetres squares and reheat at 150°C.

Tip: line the rack below with aluminium foil to catch any drips.
